symptom: `mxcli search` / `SEARCH` answers "No matches found." for a word that appears only in an element's documentation (a constant, entity, attribute, page, ...) or only in a microflow's log message, although `select ... from catalog.constants where Description like '%word%'` finds it
cause: The strings index was filled by a walk keyed on `Texts$Text` plus a few typed extractions. Documentation and a log message's `StringTemplate.Text` are plain strings, not `Texts$Text`, so the walk could not see them, and the typed extractions listed only microflow and workflow documentation and the log node name
insight: A search index fed by walking one stored type misses every field of another type, and nothing reports the gap: the missing field just answers "No matches found.". Compare the index against the catalog tables that already hold the field (`objects.Description`, `attributes_data`, ...) instead of walking the model again. Two traps: the `MODULE` row of the `objects` view has `'' as ModuleName`, so a copy keeps no module and a filter on `ModuleName` (excluding Marketplace modules) never matches the module's own documentation - use `CASE WHEN ObjectType = 'MODULE' THEN Name ELSE ModuleName END`; and a typed extraction that already indexes microflow/workflow documentation must be excluded from the generic pass or every hit shows twice. Cached catalogs keep answering "No matches found." until the schema version is bumped. Prove the fix with the pair reverted-vs-restored: both tests fail with the documentation pass and the log_message insert removed
